title: fix(core,components): one titleFormat interpolator for the record title (#10447, #10446)
body:
Fixes #10447
Fixes #10446
Clause-②: no — one renderer's private interpolation rebinds to the existing core authority, and core's empty test aligns with `recordDisplayValueAt`. No export, schema or accept set moves.

Folded pair, one branch, executed from the triage on each card (comments 5827587063 and 5827564760) and the PM claims 5828659772 / 5828664602. objectui#10446's core fix lands first, then the H1 rebinds, so no commit on this branch renders `HT-2026-003 -` in the H1.

## Commits

1. `4c140cb9c` — objectui#10446, `@object-ui/core`. `formatTitleTemplate` judges each placeholder through the value half of `recordDisplayValueAt`, now the module-private `displayValueOf`: trim, then empty, with an expanded reference reduced to its display name. It used to test the raw value against null, undefined and the empty string on its own, so a whitespace-only value counted as resolved and the final whitespace collapse left its separator dangling. One implementation of the emptiness rule instead of two spellings of it. Exported signatures unchanged.
2. `ef988ac2f` — objectui#10447, `@object-ui/components`. The record page H1's `titleFormat` rung hands the declared template (string or Expression envelope) to core's `formatTitleTemplate` and takes its answer, including core's empty "nothing resolved"; the rung's separate unresolved-token test is gone. `cleanupTitleSeparators` had no other caller and is deleted with its test file. The rungs' order (objectui#9436) does not move.
3. `47536ebd8` — a typing fix inside the same helper: the declaration build refused a copy that re-widened to possibly-undefined (TS18048).
4. `b06b17020` — prose only: two pending changesets reconciled with the rung's one interpolator (see "Reconciled pending changesets" below), and this change's changeset names both.

## Measured before the change: the two interpolators, token by token

Probe at base `6881e9e47`: the real `page:header` H1 and the header's own rung (its `interpolate` plus `cleanupTitleSeparators`, plus its "contains a brace, so decline" test) against core's `formatTitleTemplate`, same record. "declines" means the rung handed over to the unified resolver, which renders core's way.

| Token rule | header rung | core | H1 before | H1 after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{account} - {deal_no}`, `account` expanded to Acme | `Q3-042` | `Acme - Q3-042` | `Q3-042` | `Acme - Q3-042` |
| `{a} - {b}`, `b` whitespace-only | `A` | `A -` | `A` | `A` |
| `{a}, {b}`, `b` missing | `A,` | `A` | `A,` | `A` |
| `Session — {a}`, `a` missing | `Session` | empty | `Session` | next rung |
| `Static title` (no placeholder) | `Static title` | empty | `Static title` | next rung |
| `{status}`, select `in_progress` | `In Progress` | `in_progress` | `In Progress` | `In Progress` (kept) |
| `{{a}} - {{b}}` | declines | `A - B` | `A - B` | `A - B` |
| `{ a } - { b }` | declines | `A - B` | `A - B` | `A - B` |
| `{first-name} {a}` | declines | `Ada L` | `Ada L` | `Ada L` |
| value containing a brace | declines | the value | the value | the value |
| controls: dotted path, lookup with no display name, array, null, empty string, `0`, Expression envelope, the separators `·` `:` `–`, a 3-part template with its middle empty | equal | equal | equal | equal |

After the change every row where core answers non-empty has H1 equal to core (select rows: equal to core over the labelled record). Where core answers empty, the H1 walks on to the next rung, as `getRecordDisplayName` walks from its template rung.

## Select option labels (H2): kept, without touching `formatTitleTemplate`'s signature

- The header routed a top-level select token through `fieldOptionLabel`; core has no such hook.
- `withOptionLabels` builds a copy of the record whose select values read as their option labels, and the rung renders core over that copy. `optionLabelFor` is the one label lookup in the file, shared with `interpolate`, so the two readers cannot drift.
- Like-for-like with the dedupe: only top-level scalars are mapped (null, undefined, expanded references and arrays stay as they are), and a mapped value is never empty because the label falls back to the raw value. So the same placeholders resolve on the copy as on the raw record, and `record:details`, which renders the template over the raw record, still decides about the field the H1 shows. Pinned in plugin-detail (the Status-row cases below).
- In-repo census, with a lit control. Instrument: `git grep -n -E "titleFormat['\"]?\s*[:=]" -- ':!*.test.*' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'`. The one object declaration it finds outside tests is `content/docs/guide/building-crud-app.md`'s `titleFormat: '{title}'`, a text field, so no in-repo `titleFormat` names a select field. Control: the same pattern over test files is non-empty and includes `page-header-title.test.tsx`'s `{status}` select case. First-party producers outside this repo (objectstack platform objects, e.g. `sys_audit_log` with `{action} · {object_name}` and `sys_member` with `{user_id} ({role})`) do name select fields, and each of those also declares a `nameField`, so their template rung is reached only when that pointer is blank on a record. Re-derive with `git grep -n titleFormat origin/main -- 'packages/**/src/**'` in objectstack.

## `interpolate`'s callers (H3)

It keeps two callers, both `page:header`'s own templates: `title` and `subtitle`. They are unchanged. The `titleFormat` rung was the third and no longer comes through it, so `interpolate` stays. Instrument: `grep -n "interpolate(" packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`.

## Who the #10446 rule reaches (H4)

- `formatTitleTemplate` is called by `getRecordDisplayName`'s template rung (core), `DetailView.resolveDisplayTitle` and the `record:details` H1 dedupe (plugin-detail), and now `page:header`. `@object-ui/app-shell` re-exports it as `formatRecordTitle`.
- `getRecordDisplayName`, so every resolver-backed surface: app-shell `RecordDetailView`; components `page:header`; core `sort-values`; fields `index` and `LookupField`; plugin-calendar `ObjectCalendar`; plugin-detail `DetailView` and `RelatedList`; plugin-gantt `ObjectGantt`; plugin-kanban `ObjectKanban`; plugin-list `ObjectGallery`; plugin-map `ObjectMap`; plugin-tree `ObjectTree`. Instrument: `git grep -n "getRecordDisplayName(" -- 'packages/**/src/**' 'apps/**/src/**' ':!**/__tests__/**' ':!*.test.*'`.
- The existing `record-title` suites stay green, and every other test file that mentions `titleFormat` was run too (Gates below).

## Pins, red on base then green on head

New files:
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/record-title.whitespacePlaceholder-10446.test.ts`
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-title.oneInterpolator-10447.test.tsx`
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.titleFormatOneInterpolator-10447.test.tsx`

Red leg, from committed head `ef988ac2f`: both source files checked out at base `6881e9e47`, new tests kept. On-disk proof before the run: `displayValueOf` 0 hits and the old empty test 1 hit in `record-title.ts`; `withOptionLabels` 0 hits and `cleanupTitleSeparators` 2 hits in `containers.tsx`. Result `Tests 11 failed | 25 passed (36)`:
- core: THE CARD `expected 'HT-2026-003 -' to be 'HT-2026-003'` at both doors; blank leading placeholder `expected '- Acme' to be 'Acme'`; agreement rows "spaces" `expected '- K' to be 'K'` and "no-break spaces".
- `page:header`: THE CARD `expected 'Q3-042' to be 'Acme - Q3-042'`; whitespace `expected 'HT-2026-003' to be 'HT-2026-003 -'` (H1 against core); comma `expected 'Q3-042,' to be 'Q3-042'`; literal prefix `expected 'Session' not to be 'Session'`.
- `page:header` beside `record:details`: THE CARD `expected 'Q3-042' to be 'Acme - Q3-042'`; #10446 in the page `expected 'HT-2026-003' to be 'HT-2026-003 -'`.
- The 25 that stay green are the controls, including every select option-label case: the H1's label behaviour is kept, not changed.

Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD --` both paths inside an EXIT/INT/TERM trap, blob hashes equal to `ef988ac2f`'s (`d7e714385`, `86a980376`), `git diff HEAD` empty. `47536ebd8` differs from `ef988ac2f` only by the typing fix inside `withOptionLabels`, a file the red leg replaces with base, so the red and green numbers carry over. Green leg: the three files pass on head inside the package runs listed under Gates; the two render files alone read `Tests 21 passed (21)`.

## Gates

Code, type and test gates ran at `47536ebd8`; the changeset gates were re-run on the prose commit `b06b17020` (no code or test file moved between the two).

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/plugin-detail^..." build` (the dependency closure, includes core and components): exit 0.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `Done` ×3, exit 0. Each package's test program lists its new test file (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles`, 1 match per package).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/`: `Test Files 172 passed (172)`, `Tests 3501 passed (3501)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 507 passed | 2 skipped (509)`, `Tests 4976 passed | 25 skipped (5001)`.
- Every other test file that mentions `titleFormat` (app-shell, fields, plugin-dashboard, plugin-grid, plugin-map, react, types): `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 218 passed (218)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run test:dist`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`.
- `check-changeset-presence` (at `b06b17020`): `✅ 7 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/10447-one-title-interpolator.md.`
- `check:new-line-citations` (at `b06b17020`): `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `check:control-bytes` (at `b06b17020`): `✅ check-control-bytes: OK`.
- At `b06b17020`: `check-changeset-no-major` `✅ No changeset declares a major bump.`; `check-changeset-fixed` `✅ All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.`; `check:pending-changeset-literals` `✅ No test source names a pending changeset.`; `check-changeset-overwrite` exit 0, report-only, listing exactly the two reconciled entries (`2 modified, 0 deleted`); `check:changeset-claims` exit 0, report-only, and the entries it still lists name the touched files for other aspects (reviewed; none describes the `titleFormat` rung's interpolation).
- `check:test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`: exit 0.
- eslint on the six touched source and test files: 0 errors (warnings are the repo-wide `no-explicit-any` / `only-export-components` level). The package-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run; not measured here.

## Reconciled pending changesets

Two changesets still pending in the same release described the rung as rendered by the header's own interpolation. Each is reconciled in the form objectui#10533 / #10540 used, with its frontmatter byte-identical (md5 of the frontmatter block equal before and after: `3d9e2a1e59bc11924bb99ffd9eea81e3` and `ce888ebde4729564f67bca69a7928743`):

- `.changeset/9436-page-header-declared-pointer-order.md`: item 3 now reads "rendered at this change with the header's own interpolation", and "At this change, objects that declare a pointer and no `titleFormat`, and objects that declare a `titleFormat` and no pointer, render exactly as before". A dated note follows: "Dated note, 2026-09-25 — the record title's titleFormat rung now renders through core's formatTitleTemplate — objectui#10447". It states that option labels are still translated, via `withOptionLabels`, and that the order is unchanged.
- `.changeset/9174-interpolate-fastpath-trim.md`: "At this change `page:header`'s `title`/`subtitle` (and the record-title `titleFormat`) all went through `interpolate()`". The same dated note follows, stating that `title` and `subtitle` still go through `interpolate()`, so that entry's fix holds for them unchanged.
- `.changeset/10447-one-title-interpolator.md` names both entries.

Every other pending `.changeset/*.md` was re-grepped for present-tense claims about the header's own `titleFormat` interpolation or `cleanupTitleSeparators`, and none has one. Instrument: `git grep -n -i -E "cleanupTitleSeparators|separator cleanup|interpolat|formatTitleTemplate|titleFormat" -- .changeset/`. The nearest hits are about `page:header`'s `title` (objectui#10117, #8923) or other readers, and still hold.

## File surface

- `packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts`, and beside it the new `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/record-title.whitespacePlaceholder-10446.test.ts`.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, and beside it the new `page-header-title.oneInterpolator-10447.test.tsx`, a docblock-only edit to `page-header-title.test.tsx`, and the deleted `cleanup-title-separators.test.ts` (its function had no other caller).
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.titleFormatOneInterpolator-10447.test.tsx`: new, test-only, outside the claims' listed surface ("tests beside each"). It is where `page:header` and `record:details` render together (the objectui#9436 and objectui#10360 agreement files live beside it), which the H5 pin needs. No plugin-detail source changes.
- `.changeset/10447-one-title-interpolator.md` (patch on `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/components`), plus the two reconciled entries above.

## Scope

- objectui#10499 is not addressed here. The H1's row source is unchanged (`ctx.data`, the raw served row). This neither helps nor hinders that fix beyond one fact: the rung and `record:details`' dedupe now call the same function and differ only in the row they pass it.
- objectui#10462 (action-entry `params`, same file) is untouched.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour change on the rung, by the one-authority rule: a template none of whose placeholders resolves no longer shows its literal text in the H1 (`Session — {user_id}` with no user used to read `Session`); the H1 walks on to the next rung.
- A resolved placeholder now emits the trimmed string `recordDisplayValueAt` returns. After core's whitespace collapse this is visible only where a padded value sits against a non-space literal, for example `({code})`.
- `DetailView.resolveDisplayTitle` still renders the template over the raw record, so on the non-synthesized detail header a select token reads as its raw value where `page:header` shows the label. That predates this change and is read from source only, not measured through a running page.
